title: Fluctuating Kinetic Theory: A Poissonian Stochastic Boltzmann Equation
summary: We introduce a nonlinear Poissonian fluctuating Boltzmann equation whose noise encodes both the fluctuations and the path large-deviation rate function of the underlying hard-sphere gas. Unlike the Gaussian-noise equations commonly studied in fluctuating hydrodynamics, the present equation raises a new difficulty: a Poisson random measure produces jumps that may destroy the nonnegativity of the solution.
